note: The manifest of every external input to this tree, code and data alike. Nothing enters the tree undeclared (plan L0 step 3). Entries are pinned by URL and SHA-256, never by version range, because rule R11 applies to code for the same reason it applies to data: upstream is mutable and a resolver hides that. See MANIFEST.md for the format.

entries.licence_note: Boost Software License 1.0. Permissive; plan §5 constraint 3 satisfied. Chosen over doctest (MIT) and GoogleTest (BSD-3) for its floating-point matcher vocabulary — WithinAbs, WithinRel, WithinULP — which is the vocabulary the adopted L1 specifications already state their tolerances in. BSL-1.0 additionally does not require its notice to be reproduced in machine-executable object code, which is a real convenience for a tree whose own licence posture is undecided (LICENSE §2).
entries.upstream_mutable_note: A GitHub release tag archive is immutable in practice but not by guarantee; the SHA-256 is the identity, not the tag.
